caption: Terrace of the Lions, Delos
composition: Row of marble lions facing the dry Sacred Lake · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the path beside the terrace, weathered marble lions stand in profile on a low base, facing the dry Sacred Lake, where one palm rises from the basin. Low ruined walls and loose blocks surround the terrace. Midday is mainly clear, cloud cover about 23 percent, about 21.5°C, breezy, and dry. The lions outdoors are the replicas; the originals are in the site museum and are not in this frame.
